title: Trump blasts appeals court for halting White House ballroom construction, claiming decision is a ‘national security threat’ – as it happened

Cassidy, a former physician, said this week he’s concerned about Blanche’s ability to lead the justice department independently, considering he once served as Donald Trump’s personal lawyer.
